spec.userPrompt:
QUESTION PROMPT: Choisissez la phrase correcte : « Lorsque nous sommes arrivés au cinéma, la séance ___ déjà. »

CORRECT ANSWER: avait commencé

Is this correct answer grammatically valid French?

responses.raw:
VERDICT: VALID

The correct answer "avait commencé" is grammatically valid French. It is the plus-que-parfait (pluperfect) tense of the verb "commencer" conjugated with the auxiliary "avoir" (avait) in the imparfait (3rd person singular) followed by the past participle "commencé". This is the correct verb form to complete the sentence: "Lorsque nous sommes arrivés au cinéma, la séance avait déjà commencé" - expressing an action that had already occurred before another past action (arriving at the cinema).
